headline: Committee takes up Pahia Sugar Mill bills and hears owners begin presentation

meeting.body: Maui County Council Housing and Land Use Committee
meeting.summary: The committee took up Bills 109 and 115 for the Pahia Sugar Mill Redevelopment Project; Bill 115 would rezone both parcels to M1 Light Industrial. A former staff planner testified on the 1995 community plan, and the owners began a presentation.
meeting.recap: A testifier from Vermont said he led a similar project there that built a manufacturing center for job training.[[0:14:54]] Spence said he was a staff planner in 1995 when the Council adopted the Pāʻia-Haʻikū community plan.[[0:17:43]] He said the Council always meant for the site to have industrial and business uses.[[0:18:03]] Spence told a councilmember the community plan never tied the mill and the Pāʻia bypass together.[[0:19:25]] The committee took up Bills 109 and 115 for 19.933 acres in Pāʻia, for the Pāʻia Sugar Mill Redevelopment Project.[[0:22:02]] Bill 109 would change the community plan use (the long-range land plan) for one 2.5-acre parcel from Heavy Industrial to Light Industrial.[[0:22:27]] Bill 115 would rezone both parcels from Urban Reserve to M1 Light Industrial.[[0:22:41]] Managing partners of the Pāʻia Village Company, which owns the land, began a presentation.[[0:23:11]]

moments.q: Will Spence testifies on the Pāʻia Mill site history
